text:
Iris: quick proposal 1: run Advisor as read-only for beta customers, no auto-apply, to validate recs and metrics.
Ben: +1. we should track recommendation_apply_rate and a small sentinel set for accuracy checks.
Marco: infra needs lightweight headers: x-rw-model, x-rw-quant-profile, x-rw-eval-id so alerts can tie back. low overhead only.
infra-bot: canary: telemetry-proxy patch deployed to staging at 2024-11-11T10:05Z :white_check_mark:
Iris: acceptance checks for read-only pilot: 1) UI shows recs + rationale, 2) apply button disabled, 3) recommendation_apply_rate metric captured, 4) eval-run links attached to each alert.
Ben: also require a cost-safety cap per tenant (global throttle) so if recommendations increase token usage we auto-disable.
Marco: ack; will prototype header + cap and post PR. ETA Wed.
Iris: timeline: prototype headers today, internal test Friday, invite 2 pilot customers next week.
Ben: tiny UX ask 1 include a CSV export of recommendations for customers who want offline review.
Iris: adding to checklist. done. :thumbsup:
